text:
Asha: Morning — finalizing the release-train for Thursday. We have a 11:30 PT corridor. Proposed order: infra (11:30), runtime (11:40), web (11:50). Can each lane confirm an owner + smoke + rollback ready?

Luca: I can take runtime (11:40). Will run the perf smoke and KV prefix checks. @Tomas can you own infra handoff?

Tomas: I can take infra (11:30). Need someone to validate network policies post-cutover. @Nikhil?

Nikhil: I can validate network/policy checks and quick e2e for the runtime path. Will be on standby during infra window. :thumbsup:

Priya: I'll own web (11:50) and rollback validation for web. I'll also coordinate canary traffic weights.

Asha: Great. Smoke owners: infra -> Tomas, runtime -> Luca, web -> Priya. Please confirm the checklist below is OK. If any lane needs extra time, call it out now.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy windows created: infra@11:30, runtime@11:40, web@11:50. Canary policy: 5m stable -> 3-step ramp to 100%. Alerts enabled.

Asha: Smoke checklist (copy/paste during your window):
```
# quick smoke checklist
1) run smoke script: ./scripts/smoke.sh --env=prod --checks kv,latency,api
2) verify traces for the new model id in /traces?query=model:release-2026-03
3) check 95th latency + error rate in dashboard (deploy/latency -> last 10m)
4) sanity request: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'
5) if any check fails: run rollback command below
```

Asha: Rollback quick commands (keep handy):
```
# rollback one-liner examples
kubectl rollout undo deployment/infra-proxy -n prod
kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime-v2 -n prod
kubectl rollout undo deployment/web-service -n prod
```

Luca: Confirmed. I'll post smoke output in this thread when done. If runtime perf is +30% token latency, I'll cascade rollback to infra.

Tomas: For infra, extra step: run `netctl validate-policy release-2026-03` and check iptables counters. I'll paste logs if anything looks off.

Priya: For web canary, I'll use the console route to shift weights: 10% -> 50% -> 100% and watch 5xx rate. If 5xx > 1% at any step I stop and rollback.

Asha: On-call: can you pre-warm the incident channel and be ready for an urgent rollback? oncall-bot / @oncall is prepped.

oncall-bot: Oncall pager patched. If deploy-bot posts failure event I will page the SRE rotation.

Nikhil: Side note — I have a small DB migration queued that I don't want in the same train. Asha, can we move it to next window?

Asha: Yes — move DB migration to Friday morning. We'll keep this train migration-free. Good catch.

Luca: Quick question — do we want to run the extended perf job after runtime window (15m) or after web reaches 100%?

Asha: Run perf job after runtime window completes and runtime is stable (so we get a pure-runtime baseline). That way web traffic won't skew results.

Tomas: Ack. I'll hand over a short runbook snippet in the thread 30m before my window.

Priya: I'll prepare rollback quicklinks in the console and post them here.

Asha: Perfect. Final checklist: owners confirmed, smoke owners assigned, rollback commands ready, oncall primed. If no objections I'll lock the train in 30m. :rocket:

Luca: No objections from runtime. :white_check_mark:

Tomas: No objections from infra. :white_check_mark:

Priya: No objections from web. :white_check_mark:

Asha: Locking the train. I'll post the deploy manifest and the canary weights in this thread before starters. Good luck everyone.

deploy-bot: Release-train locked by Asha at 1756012345. Canary timers set. Good luck! :tada:
